topic: What trade-offs exist between array size and radiation efficiency for SIW arrays in high-gain inter-satellite antennas?
response: Trade-offs exist between array size and radiation efficiency for SIW arrays, as larger arrays experience higher insertion loss due to increased SIW length, decreasing efficiency.
reference_context: SIW array efficiency decreases with size increase, from 70% to 27.5%, due to higher insertion loss, as seen in fabricated arrays.
